mode: read-only independent UX and visual regression audit
evidence_grade: E1 independent source/image review of prior E2/E3 smoke artifacts; no new runtime execution by this reviewer
limitations: No user data inspected or mutated.
Largest text, localization, RTL, increased contrast, reduced transparency and human VoiceOver have not been validated.
Prior screenshots are static evidence, not a substitute for post-change native execution.

findings.title: Table text lacks vertical row padding
findings.root_cause: The table delegate returns a bare NSTextField while rowHeight is 38; there is no cell container with a centerY constraint and horizontal content inset.
findings.fix: Use a shared NSTableCellView containing a single-line truncating label, center it vertically, and govern horizontal inset and row height in CatalogTheme. Reuse cells by column identifier.
tests: Assert label midY equals cell midY within one point.
Capture multiple rows, selected and unselected, all categories at minimum and typical size in both appearances.

findings.title: Sidebar icons touch selection highlight edge
findings.root_cause: Borderless NSButton fills the selection background but its image/title has no content padding; row bounds are used as visual bounds.
findings.fix: Give navigation rows an explicit leading/trailing content inset while preserving the full-row hit target and native keyboard/accessibility semantics. Apply the same rule to all category rows.
tests: Measure icon and title bounds inside the selection pill; require at least 10 points leading padding.
Verify mouse, keyboard activation, selection state, and both appearances.

findings.title: Setup folder rows sit at the bottom of oversized empty lists
findings.root_cause: A natural-height NSStackView is used as an NSScrollView document view without an explicit flipped, viewport-height document container, leaving short lists bottom-aligned.
findings.fix: Use a top-aligned/flipped document container at least as tall as the viewport, anchor rows at its top, and autohide unnecessary scrollbars. Define a shared folder-list row inset.
tests: Capture zero, one, and overflowing folder lists in all setup steps.
Assert first row remains near viewport top and last row can be scrolled to; exercise Remove on overflowing lists.

findings.title: Inspector typography changes after clearing selection
findings.root_cause: Selected content sets attributed text with bold section headings; the no-selection branch replaces only detail.string, which inherits prior typing/text-storage attributes instead of resetting a semantic body style.
findings.fix: Render both selected and empty inspector content through one explicit attributed-text styling path; reset font/color and paragraph spacing each time.
tests: Select sample, then search to zero results and compare empty inspector styling with fresh launch.
Assert no-selection body font is regular 12-point and has consistent text-container inset.

findings.title: First scan hides all useful collection results until every phase completes
findings.root_cause: The loading state promises results only when the scan finishes, so discovery/metadata/reference work share one all-or-nothing collection presentation. No stop control is exposed.
findings.fix: Publish basic collection batches promptly; retain navigable search/table/selection while reference enrichment continues. Distinguish pending metadata from absent references. Provide cancel/stop with honest partial-result status and resumable rescan behavior.
tests: Measured time to first usable result and under-60-second first-use criterion on representative folders.
Verify browsing/filtering/selecting partial batches, completing enrichment, cancellation, and starting a replacement scan retain consistent state.

findings.title: Hard-coded layout dimensions lack long-text and boundary validation
findings.root_cause: Setup cards hard-code 680-point width inside a fixed 740-point panel, while shell/sidebar/inspector and controls use disparate literal spacing. Long folder names, asset titles, errors and large text have no captured boundary cases.
evidence: Static layout inspection; current screenshots contain only short asset titles and no save failure.
findings.fix: Constrain cards to parent width and centralize semantic padding roles. Bound/wrap long text deliberately and use scrollable setup body for overflowing content while preserving footer controls.
tests: Long asset and folder names, multi-line setup save error, many roots, minimum width/height, wide/short and typical windows.
Validate all action controls remain visible and no unsatisfiable constraints are logged.

findings.title: Visual pass does not detect layout regression or fully cover reachable states
findings.root_cause: Runtime smoke asserts controls and captures screenshots but has no geometry assertions, prior-image comparison, overflow text fixtures, scan-details screenshot or setup-save-error capture. It records first-baseline/no-diff and lacks measured interaction latency.
evidence: reading-progress.png shows 99% text with roughly one-third visual fill; capture may have caught native animation, so this is evidence inconsistency rather than proven progress-model failure.
findings.fix: Add layout geometry assertions and deterministic post-layout captures for all semantic components; capture determinate progress after animation settles or with animation disabled for fixture screenshots. Keep baseline comparison review explicit.
tests: Minimum/typical pairwise light/dark plus long-text, issues, error, partial/cancelled scan and all setup steps.
Actual keyboard traversal and native accessibility state checks, with human VoiceOver limitation stated.

findings.title: Status and setup summary copy has grammatical and density issues
findings.root_cause: Counts use fixed plural strings and inspector content repeats long paths and disclaimers; semantics and paragraph spacing are assembled ad hoc.
findings.fix: Centralize count formatting/pluralization and use concise project display names with full selectable path available in details/tooltip; retain the important recency-proxy explanation once.
tests: Zero/one/many count cases; large reference list scrollability and copyable full paths.
